QuestInfo.name: Knighthood Exam: Dawn Warrior
QuestInfo.0: According to #p1101002#, you can take your Knighthood Exam if you go see #b#p1101003##k, the Chief Knight of Light. Better head over to Ereve and meet #p1101003#.
QuestInfo.1: The Knighthood Exam has started. The test itself is actually quite simple. You just need to reach the end of the Training Forest, enter #bthe 2nd Drill Hall#k, and defeat the Tiguru inside while bringing back #t4032096#. Better find #b30 #t4032096#s#k and bring them back to #p1101003#. \n\n#i4032096# #t4032096# #b#c4032096# / 30#k
QuestInfo.2: You have successfully completed the Knighthood Exam and officially dropped the 'in-Training' from your title. As a bona fide Cygnus Knight, do your best to work hard so you will never be ashamed of yourself.

0.0: Do you wish to take the Knighthood Exam? Based on your contributions to Cygnus Knights so far, it is indeed hard to keep you here as the Knight-in-Training. Fine, I will let you take the Knighthood Exam. Are you ready?

yes.0: The test is rather simple. Enter #bthe 2nd Drill Hall#k located at the end of the Training Forest, defeat the Mimis inside, and bring back the #b#t4032096#s#k that they have with them. I need #b30#k.
yes.1: If you can bring all the #t4032096#s back, then I will grant you the right to become a Knight. At this point, I need your skills to do the talking.

no.0: Talk to me when you are ready to take the test.

item.0: I don't think you have found #b30 #t4032096#s#k yet. Go to #bHall #2#k and find them.
